name: Ziad Hares
title: Chief Technology Officer, Begad · Founder, Computator Technology
headline: CTO at Begad · founder of Computator Technology · cybersecurity & systems engineer
hero_subtitle: BSc Cybersecurity (UOWD) · graduating Dec 2026 · Dubai, UAE. Running production e-commerce, hardened infrastructure and local-first AI for UAE clients. Open to security engineering roles and consulting engagements.
summary: Chief Technology Officer of Begad, a bilingual UAE marketplace (begad.ae) on PHP 8.3, MariaDB and AWS, and founder of Computator Technology, a Dubai DET-licensed software and managed-IT practice. Final-year BSc Cybersecurity student (UOWD, graduating Dec 2026) and president of the UOWD Tech Club. At Begad: fixed revenue-critical payment and stock defects, rebuilt ad attribution, shipped iOS/Android apps, runs an ISO/IEC 27001-aligned security programme and recovered the platform from git after its production instance was deleted. Background in penetration testing, hardened self-hosted infrastructure (WireGuard, Matrix E2EE, Traefik, Proxmox) and local-first AI systems. Comfortable owning a production system end to end: threat model, build, deploy, recover.
about: Chief Technology Officer at Begad, a bilingual UAE marketplace, and founder of Computator Technology, a Dubai-licensed software and managed-IT practice, while finishing a BSc in Cybersecurity. Since August 2026 I have owned Begad's technology end to end: I closed payment and stock defects, rebuilt ad attribution, shipped the iOS and Android apps, run its ISO/IEC 27001-aligned security programme, and brought the platform back from git history after its production server was deleted with no backups.

Through Computator I build and run systems for clients: a luxury auction engine with an immutable bid ledger for BHF Auctions, Komissio, a local-first company operating system, a real-estate intelligence platform and technology strategy for Mon Adoptive Technology, and brand-led websites. At university I lead the Tech Club and its cybersecurity team. Outside client work I keep a Proxmox pentest range, a self-hosted WireGuard and Matrix E2EE stack, and a local-first contract-analysis platform built for my capstone. I care about systems that are secure by construction, documented well enough to rebuild, and honest about what they can and cannot do.

bullets: Own technology for a bilingual UAE marketplace end to end: platform engineering, AWS infrastructure, payments, mobile apps, analytics and security, with 2,400+ production commits across storefront, checkout, wallet, seller payouts, logistics tracking, admin and seller portals.

Run Begad's ISO/IEC 27001-aligned information security programme: role separation and least privilege across admin and seller portals, signed Stripe webhooks with replay protection, checked routes for seller identity and bank documents, versioned migrations, automated backups with tested recovery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and a self-hosted mail server, audit logging, admin account recovery and patched hosts; closed out a security and money audit in Nov 2026.
Closed revenue leaks: orders were confirmed and stock deducted before Stripe capture; gated confirmation strictly post-payment and added Stripe Payment Element (Apple/Google Pay) and Tabby BNPL.
Rebuilt ad attribution from zero e-commerce events to full-funnel Meta Conversions API + TikTok Events API with event_id deduplication and SHA-256 hashed match data.

Restored the platform from git history after the production instance was deleted with no backups (Aug 2026); then introduced versioned migrations, automated backups, GitHub Actions CI/CD and infrastructure runbooks.
Cut UAE page latency: CloudFront origin keep-alive tuning, tracking-parameter cache normalisation, stale-while-revalidate page caches and edge caching of guest and signed-in pages.

Shipped iOS/Android apps (Capacitor with native Swift/Java bridges), an iMessage extension, Sign in with Apple, and a public agent API (catalog, search, product, MCP tools, llms.txt) so AI assistants can shop the catalogue.
Launched vidvie.ae, the UAE distributor site for the VIDVIE brand, fed live from the Begad API; private S3 + CloudFront, GitHub OIDC deploys with no stored keys, Route 53 DNS.
Set direction for Begad's mobile launch, Libya market expansion and agent-commerce roadmap under a 12-month engineering agreement (Sep 2026).
Launched Begad Food (food.begad.ae), expanding core marketplace infrastructure into food delivery with integrated administrative management and dedicated ordering workflows.
Automated Fulfilled by Begad (FBB) seller warehouse pickups, engineering address and geospatial coordinate validation with scheduled logistics dispatch.
Rebuilt vidvie.ae as a white-label marketplace served via CloudFront with static page generation and automated bilingual guides syndicated from Begad content.
Enhanced the logistics driver suite with real-time job push updates, offline-resilient route refresh, and bidirectional shipment editing.
